| | Dear Fellow American,

I'm excited to let you know we've produced a free video that explains the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

[**It 's called "The Electoral College Explained."**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=942abeea841241d0a8bc3f8e68bc6fdb&_e=ZX4VhZAqhwXcf_h93he8dc8D8qp1Gmz_6lTgeZ_Ii9XzNF0-OiIVEe0Cy6Y0s5kh0rYmWv1DBe_83n1b8yKha-Go4TpgZTkhsd3tBbnu_Qv30OnfZzyaKGg7Qr3b1CxPACTfXrMvVTK1isHcG2DXYWOq1VbnKHp76E8UZf5FNov4j_f_XLzynpvKJaM0IwbUKb1uBxzzj3DiS31bMhsfEdWUy2k_J-IcTHq_gLoxlfufE3EHDeJDHgIQFcj0fCKuSmeF-5PeL2OJY_aHuvVySpuJ6StNruBNswP5aQ7WZg6-5i3LUDPjRLtC-bnLGYFyn8w__DJKuFfgeKOF2ebn0_bnsydBjGSROeROEKigkOJcug71keWYUaqeurfqmrgIxlYhNG7i0NrS5wI1v1l6ww%3D%3D)

This 12-minute video is full of information about the Electoral College, why we have this system, and what would happen if we replaced it with a national popular vote.

But now that the video is made and out there on the web--I need patriotic Americans like you to watch it. We want more than 300,000 people to watch the video in the next few weeks.

Can you help us by watching this short video today?

**Here 's a link to watch the video. **

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-video**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=942abeea841241d0a8bc3f8e68bc6fdb&_e=ZX4VhZAqhwXcf_h93he8dc8D8qp1Gmz_6lTgeZ_Ii9XzNF0-OiIVEe0Cy6Y0s5kh0rYmWv1DBe_83n1b8yKha-Go4TpgZTkhsd3tBbnu_Qv30OnfZzyaKGg7Qr3b1CxPACTfXrMvVTK1isHcG2DXYWOq1VbnKHp76E8UZf5FNov4j_f_XLzynpvKJaM0IwbUKb1uBxzzj3DiS31bMhsfEdWUy2k_J-IcTHq_gLoxlfufE3EHDeJDHgIQFcj0fCKuQpoAgNe1f0WJATUt1MRLlMolR-Xvr8n6KPwMG-gQ1CReIO_uMW-w5aUVJdQf5PdYqBoLbhJ_pZsTsvNNtwIsmxv0bN4_oCk2cRWZKVsZRCrUoCRzLgTGXWh8WtQ1vqhzV0-VyHCEflGO-fQJ1nKrZA%3D%3D)

When you watch, you'll better understand everything we stand to lose if we replace the Electoral College with a national popular vote.

Thanks for your help.

Warm regards,

Labin Duke, Th.M.

Hillsdale College

clean_body: I just recorded a video about why voting is a chess move, not a love letter. | | | Peter: Has anyone ever tried to tell you that your vote doesn’t matter? That politicians alone can save us from our problems? That it doesn’t make a difference who’s in power? None of this is true — and that’s why I just recorded a video for this final week of the campaign about why voting is a chess move, not a love letter. Here are the top five lies that I hear all the time about elections: 1\. “The two party system is never going to change.” WRONG. The Working Families Party is building a viable and strategic third party — taking out corporate Democrats in primaries, electing our own candidates, and fighting to change the rules themselves. 2\. “Politicians can save us from our problems!” WRONG. Elections aren't just about the candidates. They're about the conditions that we want to fight in over the next few decades. We have to play the long game. 3\. “It doesn't matter who's in power.” WRONG. From New York to Colorado to New Mexico, WFP has organized after successful elections to raise wages, guarantee paid sick time and family leave, invest in quality public schools, and more. 4\. “I only need to vote for President.” WRONG. School budgets, housing public transportation funding, and how well your streets are maintained are set by elected officials like state legislators and city council members. 5\. “Voting for someone means I have to agree with them on every single thing.” WRONG. This is chess, not a love letter. Voting for someone doesn’t mean you are co-signing every single thing they've done or ever will do. It is a collective act — one tactic in a strategy. We’re voting strategically for the best conditions to fight for the things we need for all of our people — things like healthcare for all, affordable education, and housing that doesn’t cost your entire paycheck. With voting already underway in almost every state, we need to make sure we’re reaching every last person in our lives about the stakes of this election, and our plans beyond it. In solidarity, Maurice Mitchell National Director Working Families Party Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. Well, with a whole lot of hard work (including working in a doughnut shop to help my family get by), long hours, and a ton of hope, we were able to win our American dream. After putting myself through college, I worked for several nonprofit organizations across Florida, helping to **protect our wildlife and preserve our coral reefs.** Rick Scott, on the other hand, banned saying the words "climate change" when he was governor of Florida, and the League of Conservation Voters gave him a whopping 0% score last year. But Rick Scott has voted to repeal the Affordable Care Act more times than I care to count. And who can forget he committed one of the largest Medicare frauds in the history of our country. Eventually, I had the honor of serving my community in the U.S. House of Representatives, where I became the first South American immigrant to be elected to Congress! clean_body: | | | Peter — by now, with just 8 days until Election Day, I hope you have a good sense of who I am and the issues I believe are so important. But I thought a little reminder would be helpful, especially contrasted with who Rick Scott is 🤮. First and foremost, I'm everything I am today because of my mother. She brought my sisters and me to America when I was just 14. Mom knew we had to get out of Ecuador, which was transitioning to democracy after suffering under a military dictatorship. She knew America was the key to a better life. Well, with a whole lot of hard work (including working in a doughnut shop to help my family get by), long hours, and a ton of hope, we were able to win our American dream. My story is what inspires me to give back to this incredible country and state that gave me so much. After putting myself through college, I worked for several nonprofit organizations across Florida, helping to protect our wildlife and preserve our coral reefs. Rick Scott, on the other hand, banned saying the words "climate change" when he was governor of Florida, and the League of Conservation Voters gave him a whopping 0% score last year. During my time working at Florida International University, I spearheaded a new program to expand affordable health care access to more Floridians. But Rick Scott has voted to repeal the Affordable Care Act more times than I care to count. And who can forget he committed one of the largest Medicare frauds in the history of our country. Eventually, I had the honor of serving my community in the U.S. House of Representatives, where I became the first South American immigrant to be elected to Congress! In the House, I wrote the bill to expand seniors’ Medicare Advantage coverage, worked with Republicans to provide economic relief to families and small businesses, and secured $200 million for Everglades restoration. I'm proud of my record — but can Rick Scott say the same, friend? He has used his time in office writing the plan to end Social Security and Medicare, attempting to undermine our elections, attacking our rights, and making it harder for working families to get ahead. As a result, Rick Scott's approval ratings with Floridians are underwater. Even a large percentage of Republicans don't approve of him! Now, polling shows me statistically tied with Scott, and in just 8 days, we can defeat him and protect our Democratic Senate majority in the process. I'm thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

Perhaps you've wondered where the artwork accompanying the lectures in our free online courses comes from. We hear this especially for one of our most popular courses, "The Genesis Story."

The Book of Genesis has inspired some of Western Civilization's greatest artists to produce iconic works. You may be familiar with Michelangelo's "The Creation of Adam" and Rembrandt's "The Sacrifice of Issac."

I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel...

[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/9R_WJjrnNxqfOg_pZDb3mA~~/AARclAA~/RgRpAmpcP0S_~) **We 've compiled these paintings, along with many others featured in this course, into a brand-new coffee table book, "The Genesis Story: Course Companion." And I'd like you to receive a copy.**

And with these works all in one place, you and your family can enjoy page after page of divinely inspired art.

**You can reserve your copy of "The Genesis Story: Course Companion," an exclusive hard-cover book from Hillsdale College, for a generous donation of $100 or more by clicking the secure link below: **

Team,

We’re barely over a week away from Election Day, and there’s a lot at stake. I’d like to take a moment to explain why – as a high-risk OB/GYN – I’m supporting Kristin Lyerly, as is my (former Packers coach!) dad Mike Holmgren, and why **[_I’m asking you to join us in these critical final days._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96003745/508599969/246552325?refcode=KL_ATA_EM_FR_Holmgren_241028_T1_1&utm_source=kl_ata_em_fr_holmgren_241028_t1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NjUxOWU2MS01Mjk1LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4mjVrQeF49DXTxig5SHmsMU-spcp8XiQwGDNA-iDZQg=)**

As an OB/GYN who focuses specifically on high-risk pregnancies, I’ve seen my fair share of hard cases.

I’ve been in the room with patients facing agonizing choices, and been the one to deliver news no parent wants to hear.

**Kristin Lyerly has been in the same position, as a fellow OB/GYN.** Both of us understand one essential thing: None of these decisions should be made by politicians. They should be made by the people whose lives they change, and the experts in charge of their care.

**So today, I’m proud to stand with Kristin and support her campaign for Congress – because we need representatives who understand the stakes instead of relying on political grandstanding.**

The reality is that the Supreme Court’s decision overturning _Roe v. Wade_ has cost patients their lives. And it will cost more lives until we enact federal legislation that ensures that reproductive health care is legal and accessible for all.

**[_So please – will you stand with me in supporting my fellow OB/GYN Kristin Lyerly for Congress? Chip in to her campaign right now >>_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96003746/508599970/246552325?refcode=KL_ATA_EM_FR_Holmgren_241028_T1_1&utm_source=kl_ata_em_fr_holmgren_241028_t1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NjUxOWU2MS01Mjk1LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4mjVrQeF49DXTxig5SHmsMU-spcp8XiQwGDNA-iDZQg=)**

Thank you,

Dr. Calla Holmgren

body:
Peter — it’s Shelbi, Jon Tester’s Campaign Manager. I just made a tough decision that you need to hear about immediately.
**According to several recent reports, Tim Sheehy lied about his military service.**
1. On the campaign trail, Sheehy claimed he had a gunshot wound in his arm from combat. But according to the **_New York Times_** , public records, and firsthand accounts — including a Navy SEAL who served with Sheehy — his gunshot wound was from accidentally shooting himself in the arm in Glacier National Park.
2. Days later, **_NBC News_** released another bombshell report stating Sheehy lied about being “medically discharged” from the Navy.

It’s shocking — and Montanans must know the truth but we’re running out of time.
So I made the difficult decision to launch more television and digital ads today. The money isn’t in the budget yet — but with polls in the margin of error, **running these final ads could be enough to break the tie in Jon’s favor and win this race.**

I’m confident grassroots supporters like you — who’ve stepped up time and time again — will help us win this Senate race. With just 8 days until Election Day, Jon and our team need you now more than ever. Thank you, Shelbi Campaign Manager Team Tester

Peter – it’s Shelbi, Jon Tester’s Campaign Manager. I just made a tough decision that you need to hear about immediately.
**According to several recent reports, Tim Sheehy lied about his military service.**
1. On the campaign trail, Sheehy claimed he had a gunshot wound in his arm from combat. But according to the _**New York Times**_ , public records, and firsthand accounts—including a Navy SEAL who served with Sheehy—his gunshot wound was from accidentally shooting himself in the arm in Glacier National Park.
2. Days later, _**NBC News**_ released another bombshell report stating Sheehy lied about being “medically discharged” from the Navy.

It’s shocking—and Montanans must know the truth but we’re running out of time.
So I made the difficult decision to launch more television and digital ads today. The money isn’t in the budget yet—but with polls in the margin of error, **running these final ads could be enough to break the tie in Jon’s favor and win this race.**

| | | Brian, the fifth of five boys, was born in Salt Lake City.

[](https://king4ut.us/l/Ual9Zl6Aum9y)

Returning to Utah after his mission for the LDS church in St. Louis, Missouri, Brian’s decision to follow in his family's legal footsteps unfolded organically. Three out of five brothers became lawyers, and Brian decided to become a trial lawyer representing individuals who have been harmed by insurers’ wrongful denial of claims.

The intertwining of family, career, and public service defines Brian's narrative. As an LDS Bishop in the mid-1990s, he embraced connecting with people during vulnerable moments. Political service became a natural extension of Brian's commitment to community. Elected to the State Legislature in 2008, he later assumed the role of House Minority Leader from 2015 to 2023. In navigating the complexities of legislation, Brian learned the art of thoughtful disagreement for the better—a principle he carried into the legislative sphere from his personal and professional life.

In 2022, Brian's life took a new turn when he married Ann Silverberg Williamson, adding twin daughters and a son to his family. Their Brady Bunch family of seven children, along with three grandkids, gathers for family dinners on Mondays. These visits encapsulate the essence of shared values and a commitment to open dialogue.

body:

---
|
---
**THE TRUMP CAMPAIGN’S HATE FOR PUERTO RICO IS UNACCEPTABLE AND ANTI-AMERICAN**
---
_Declaración proporcionada en español a continuación_
---
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** **October 28, 2024**
**Contact: Kait Ahern — communications@yda.org**
---
WASHINGTON, D.C. – Yesterday, Donald Trump allowed his dangerous and delusional crusade against “the enemy within” to take center stage at his New York City rally. Rally speaker Tony Hinchcliffe called Puerto Rico “an island of trash in the ocean” before railing against “the fucking illegals” and making crass comments about Latino Americans’ sex lives and families. It was no accident that the Trump campaign platformed a racist, anti-immigrant and anti-American rant in New York City—a city of immigrants home to almost 600,000 Puerto Ricans. They want their hate to be heard and felt where it will hurt the most.

Donald Trump’s campaign scapegoats and villainizes Puerto Rico because their over 3 million disenfranchised American citizens aren’t able to vote against him. He has nothing to offer voters other than fear of their fellow Americans; that is not democracy—it’s demagoguery.

In this election, voters from the 50 United States will have to vote against hate and elect Kamala Harris. After this election, we must continue to work towards a more just America, so that the citizens of Puerto Rico and the Douglas Commonwealth can vote along with us.

---
###
---
**EL ODIO DE LA CAMPAÑA DE TRUMP HACIA PUERTO RICO ES INACEPTABLE Y ANTIAMERICAN
**
---
**PARA PUBLICACIÓN INMEDIATA** **28 de octubre de 2024** **Contacto: Kait Ahern —communications@yda.org**
---
WASHINGTON, D.C. – Ayer, Donald Trump, permitió que su campaña delirante y peligrosa contra “los enemigos interiores” ocupara el centro del escenario en su “rally” de Nueva York. Tony Hinchcliffe, orador del “rally”, llamo a Puerto Rico “una isla de basura flotante” antes de despotricar a los “fucking illegales” y hacer comentarios groseros sobre la vida intima y familiar de los latinoamericanos.

No es casualidad que la campaña de Trump presentara un discurso racista, anti-inmigrante y anti-americano en Nueva York, una ciudad de inmigrantes donde viven casi 600.000 puertorriqueños. Quieren que su odio se oiga y se sienta donde mas duela.

La campaña de Donald Trump utiliza a Puerto Rico como un chivo expiatorio y come villano porque sabe que sus mas de 3 millones de ciudadanos estadunidenses, privados de su derecho al voto, no pueden votar contra el. No tiene nada que ofrecer a los votantes aparte del miedo a sus compatriotas: esto no es democracia, es demagogia.

clean_body: How I went from saving every cent possible to ok'ing nearly every expense. | = Team, My job as Finance Director is simple: Money — both raising it and figuring out where we're going to spend it. Most of the time, I'm making sure almost nothing is going out the door except rent and our staff pay. Every penny we can hold back, I fight to keep in our piggy bank. But now? Now is the time we smash open that metaphorical piggy bank and spend every cent to elect Democrats up and down the ballot here in Ohio. At this point, the piggy bank is nearly drained. But there are still plenty of expenses like printing flyers for canvassers to leave at voters' homes, getting more phones for our phone banks, and snapping up last-minute ad space. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will be processed immediately: = = = = = = The day after Election Day — I'd rather see a balance of $0 on our ledger and know that we put everything we could into winning than sit on a few thousand dollars that could have swung a critical race. When I think about why I'm running for Congress, I think about my kids -- specifically my daughter, Maya.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96010225/508613150/2104826962?refcode=em-10.28.24-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYjlmZDVmZi01OTk1LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=S2y73zCxByHoW3ERLAw4pcnllGuc1oZGL3DN5e9jOMA=)
I'll never forget the day seven years ago when Maya came home from kindergarten and told me about some “exercises” she’d done with her classmates. She didn't quite understand what was going on, but I realized she was describing an active shooter drill.

It hit me at that moment; we now live in a country where millions of Americans fear that a hug goodbye before school, a concert, or even church, could be the last.

I also think about the Supreme Court's ruling on _Roe v. Wade_. Right now, Maya is on a path to have less control over her body than my wife, or even my mom, did. I never imagined that was possible, and it's completely unacceptable.

**The problem we face is that a major political party in our country is not willing to take common sense steps to save lives. The good news is we have the power to change that; if we can change who represents us in Congress.**

My Republican opponent Mike Garcia co-sponsored a bill that would create a nationwide ban on abortion _without exceptions_. Literally days after the mass shooting in Uvalde, Texas, Garcia was taking cash from a pro-gun group that opposes background checks.

My campaign to unseat Mike Garcia is one of the most important races in taking Congress back from extremists. Republicans hold a slim majority and **CA-27 is one of the most competitive toss-up districts in the entire country.**

**[If you're with me, help my campaign finish strong and hit our fundraising goal by sending in a contribution of $5, $35, $50, whatever amount you can, to flip CA-27 and bring some common sense back to Washington.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96010226/508613151/2104826962?refcode=em-10.28.24-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYjlmZDVmZi01OTk1LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=S2y73zCxByHoW3ERLAw4pcnllGuc1oZGL3DN5e9jOMA=)**

clean_body: | = Peter, = When I think about why I'm running for Congress, I think about my kids -- specifically my daughter, Maya. = I'll never forget the day seven years ago when Maya came home from kindergarten and told me about some “exercises” she’d done with her classmates. She didn't quite understand what was going on, but I realized she was describing an active shooter drill. It hit me at that moment; we now live in a country where millions of Americans fear that a hug goodbye before school, a concert, or even church, could be the last. I also think about the Supreme Court's ruling on Roe v. Wade. Right now, Maya is on a path to have less control over her body than my wife, or even my mom, did. I never imagined that was possible, and it's completely unacceptable. The problem we face is that a major political party in our country is not willing to take common sense steps to save lives. The good news is we have the power to change that; if we can change who represents us in Congress. My Republican opponent Mike Garcia co-sponsored a bill that would create a nationwide ban on abortion without exceptions. Literally days after the mass shooting in Uvalde, Texas, Garcia was taking cash from a pro-gun group that opposes background checks. My campaign to unseat Mike Garcia is one of the most important races in taking Congress back from extremists. subject: What is WRONG with Her?
body:
You have the power. Help us fight the inhumane lies and downright WRONG tactics of Neil's opponent. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=8dd9ecb765)

| | Peter, This is not a fun email to write.

This weekend, Neil's opponent, April McClain-Delaney, had her paid staff hand flyers to children and their families with horrifying images and very upsetting lies. These people were there to enjoy family time during Hagerstown's Mummer's Day parade. Instead, parents likely had to explain to their children what the frightening images and words meant.

What is wrong with her?

The Alsatia Club of Hagerstown hosts a family-friendly, annual parade that is one of the biggest parades in Maryland. Candidates for office are not allowed in the parade to allow the participants to enjoy a friendly, non-contentious celebration. Unfortunately, April McClain-Delaney took this opportunity to place lies into the hands of alarmed parade-watchers.

In political campaigns, you expect a little mid-slinging. But this goes FAR beyond that. She is literally spending hundreds of thousands of dollars just this week accusing Neil of unspeakable things \- Things NO ONE should have to explain to their children!

WE NEED YOUR HELP! We have 8 days left. 4 days left for Early Voting. Could you take 2 hours to stand at a local poll in a green shirt? Bring a friend, bring your kids, bring a lawn chair... We'll get official shirts and literature to you!

name: PoliticsPA
subject: Game Changer in Attorney General Race
body:
Tune into the latest installment of the Voices of Reason podcast. | | | |
---
| | | Welcome to the latest edition of _Voices of Reason_ where we’ll recap exclusive news and data featured in our most recent podcast.

Hear from all three candidates for PA Attorney General in this game-changing forum, diving into **A.I., social media's impact on children, healthcare, local DA's impact on retail theft**, and much more.

**Eugene DePasquale** and **Dave Sunday** , plus Forward Party candidate **Eric Settle** shared insights you won't want to miss.
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| **Democratic Candidate for AG Eugene DePasquale** reacts to pushback on Philly DA Krasner's progressive policies, stating, "There are specific areas where I disagree with DA Larry Krasner. Particularly on retail theft where I think even he has made some adjustments because – and I don't want to speak for him – I think he even knows he went too far on that." [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=20038dae02&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**Republican Candidate for AG Dave Sunday** touched on trust in our state's elections, sharing, "We protect Democracy by enforcing the law." Sunday continued, "It doesn't matter who you want to win. The expectation is that everyone will do this safely, you will follow the law, and you will accept the outcome when it's over." [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b5b87ed5a4&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**Forward Party Candidate for AG Eric Settle** shares that "the Forward Party doesn't have any particular positions as a party – the Forward Party is going to let candidates make up their own minds for what is center, or 'in the middle', for their state." [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2daf662f34&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
* * *
---
| **Numbers You Need to Know**
---
| _Public Opinion_
* 54% of Americans say social media companies **shouldn’t allow any political ads. [[Pew Research](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=64a79340e4&e=b7b3eddce2)]**
* **PA voters are pessimistic** about conditions in the state with 48% reporting the state is “off on the wrong track.” [[F&M Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c3eafdfb5c&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Voter Interests_
* Concern about the economy, including unemployment and higher gas and utility prices, **continue as the most important and often mentioned problem** facing PA at 35%. [[F&M Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2d34f4ff25&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Elections_
* Harris leads Trump, 48% to 44%, among **registered voters** , but Trump leads Harris, 50% to 49%, among **likely voters** in PA. [[F&M Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=f64b0e184c&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* U.S. Rep. Susan Wild (D) **holds a 51% to 45% lead** over PA Rep. Ryan Mackenzie (R) in PA's 7th Congressional District race. [[Muhlenberg](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c7a43d8fea&e=b7b3eddce2)]

---
|
* * *
---
| **DePasquale Zeros in on Protecting Pennsylvanians from A.I. & Predatory Social Media Algorithms**
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=7d3201d41a&e=b7b3eddce2 "PA Attorney General Candidates on Economy, Healthcare, Crime, and More – Keystone Candidate Forum")
---
|
* * *
---
| **Coming Up...**
---
| Airing later this week, you will hear from**House Minority Leader Bryan Cutler** on the GOP caucus's initiatives should they reclaim the House majority this November.

Plus, **Auditor General Tim DeFoor** details his office's **wide-reaching initiatives** in a possible second term. You won't want to miss it.
---
|
---
|
* * *
---
| _In Case You Missed It..._

As PA approaches the pivotal 2024 election, the race for the presidency is too close to call. Two veteran Republican strategists—**one supporting Harris, the other backing Trump** —shared their insights on the stakes ahead.

Plus, **Rep. Scott Perry** appeared in an exclusive preview of the Keystone Candidate Forum. Don't miss it!
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=613608ce77&e=b7b3eddce2 "PA Republicans for Harris Debate + Rep. Scott Perry Keystone Forum Preview | Voices of Reason Ep. 10")
---
| The _Voices of Reason_ podcast has covered the most important issues in Pennsylvania politics – from [education funding](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0a5d59028a&e=b7b3eddce2) to [trust in elections](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=4b5c499efc&e=b7b3eddce2). Secretary of the Commonwealth [Al Schmidt](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=3f8f7ce5f9&e=b7b3eddce2), PA Treasurer [Stacy Garrity](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=52e8852082&e=b7b3eddce2), and House Appropriations Chairman [Jordan Harris](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=1c79e1dce2&e=b7b3eddce2) are just a few of many influential guests who have joined us for exclusive interviews and roundtable discussions.

**Kamala Harris is as desperate as throwing up a buzzer-beater full-court shot attempt, and she 's primed to airball her attempt.**

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=57a6f311f21c46aa9045cf11ccf3f984&_e=Z_ftYP6DWywMa7pUaWZ45jL0kM_xYees7dq8_4FzQH6vuch6bObjJwk3u1_a2zpdmzGSpHCCBhgSmQT4CXQEHr-EBe3PdgjK7N2EQV_Wqbr0ih22zVLzJ9X_C32PmDATvOor_WmrE2QJaSDeprguM_4_ARXpexKAuCuheczwgNrUrAFM3s4PaFWCsVzdyWvOoJskUN4EA23eMjFC6PXaFw8xVIINQrHVhb79ZOb6ntiE8Y385Dz3ykjQZHRRHqevQzhtiuaQAkjzBH00QpFyoQ6cdZGO6VWeS5XNHisDHThRP4djskPtcy4tzwktFQAWFmOfhk98Z3N837rdezpdKQ%3D%3D)

I am SICK AND TIRED of Democrats telling me who to vote for and how to think. I am SICK AND TIRED of them thinking the Black community is a bunch of political slaves who will do whatever they want us to do whenever they want us to do it.

| [ **THE PEOPLE ARE COMING!** ](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=57a6f311f21c46aa9045cf11ccf3f984&_e=Z_ftYP6DWywMa7pUaWZ45jL0kM_xYees7dq8_4FzQH6vuch6bObjJwk3u1_a2zpdmzGSpHCCBhgSmQT4CXQEHr-EBe3PdgjK7N2EQV_Wqbr0ih22zVLzJ9X_C32PmDATocu3LCMM3gw-xVEaDptqoWEeSQW7K6uQaFjK8XVhaxiNO0ZscUOfYaY4uPAIXi132pBg9XiYanNKJlB67fNc0JEdQiXi_7KsZCRINWkDcliU_EqVffr66dehpZIFSfs4eb-JDp9wJ8g_Vjzzg86cvXulXuurnvxklhNkJGSKowIEKFL_bJ248nSZy8fuhu5ROcAaoSbZqElzEFtgQ8MvZw%3D%3D)

We are NOT slaves; we are NOT servants.

Thank you,
Royce White

Meet Royce White:

**Born and raised in the Twin Cities, Royce White was the son of a single mother and started playing sports at the age of 5 years old. Living in various neighborhoods growing up, much of his family remained in the Rondo community, where he spent much of his time and received schooling. White excelled at basketball and recieved a scholarship to play basketball at the University of Minnesota, and later transferred to Iowa State. He would go on to make Dean's List while receiving All Big-12 first-team honors and many other basketball awards.

_After being selected 16th overall by The Houston Rockets in the NBA draft, White began to voice concerns about the NBA 's collective bargaining agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist. Eventually, his concerns became a public dispute between White and the NBA. This resulted in White demanding that the NBA, as a representative of the global corporate community, take up the responsibility of spearheading the mental health conversation - not just posturing through press statements, but through policy._

Royce then went on to win two championships in Canada before moving over to play Big 3 Basketball. White appeared at a game in a t-shirt that read "Free The Uyghurs." After a game-winning basket, White did a post-game interview on CBS, where he called for 2 Million Uyghurs to be freed and released from concentration camps. As the season went on, White would touch on taboo topics such as Gain of Function Research, The Federal Reserve, Julian Assange, Edward Snowden, Larry Hoover, Jeff Fort, Muammar Gaddafi, The Great Reset, Ivermectin, Me Too, etc.

Now, Royce White is running for Senate in Minnesota to take down the Radical Left. Republicans have not seen recent success in Minnesota, but Royce's campaign is different: a grassroots movement that's sick of the Radical Agenda pushed by Far Left Democrats Amy Klobuchar and Ilhan Omar. Royce needs your help to pull off a fourth quarter comeback victory and FLIP Minnesota Red for Republicans.

| | Caroleene Dobson is a distinguished attorney, wife, mother, District Two resident, and a lifelong advocate for conservative values. Born and raised in Beatrice, Alabama, Dobson grew up on her family's fifth-generation cattle farm, where she learned the meaning of hard work and developed a firsthand understanding of the challenges faced by hardworking families and entrepreneurs. Currently practicing real estate law at the Maynard Nexsen law firm, Dobson represents a diverse clientele, including homebuilders, retailers, small business owners, and private landowners. She has spent her career advocating for her client’s interests while also achieving tangible, positive outcomes. In Congress, she will hold true to her core conservative values while ensuring Washington D.C. is working for the people of District Two. A passionate advocate for families, farms, and faith, Dobson aims to preserve the bedrock values and moral backbone that have defined our nation. With a call for Alabama common sense, she is determined to challenge the far-left agenda in Washington, D.C., advocating for the rights of property owners and defending the freedom to think, speak, and act without interference. Caroleene, alongside her husband Bobby, is the proud parent of two daughters, Philippa and Lydia. Her decision to run for Congress is deeply rooted in a desire to secure a future for her children and to champion the principles that have made America the land of the free.

subject: The airwaves are being flooded by my opponent.
body:

| | | | |
#

Ballot are in the mail in Montana, and people are starting to vote. No surprise that the corporate lobbyists running my opponents campaign are dumping their money into the airwaves of Montana -- telling lies about my record and my experience as a judge.
They have to lie because their own candidate --**my opponent -- is not qualified for anything but carrying the water for the lobbyists he’s actually paying to run his campaign.**(Of course, the money he raised is coming from the lobbyists in the first place.)
We’re under attack and we need your help.
[**I’m confident that you will not believe the lies. I need your help to be certain that other Montana voters know the truth about my candidacy to be Montana’s next Chief Justice of the Supreme Court.**](https://lynchformontana.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=179e5534b0fac3e64994314a9&id=04b59fc530&e=9e9e92f018)

body:
They are the best of us, and we owe them our thanks every day — but especially today.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96010692/508614984/-330727681?refcode=logo&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTI0OTciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjBmYmI2NTktNWI5NS1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=tntB3oTHt4VqEOSXBZz40jfYgdhQ485Osjpc2xymYgk=) Today is National First Responders Day, friend.

On this day we honor the first responders who put their lives on the line every day to protect the rest of us.

Georgians owe a special thanks to our first responders this year. Hurricane Helene battered our state, destroying homes and farms while leaving entire neighborhoods devastated. Dozens of Georgians lost their lives, including multiple first responders.

**Crises like these show us who we really are.**

In my years as a working pastor, I’ve seen time and time again how people are shaped by fear and doubt. Most of the time we run away, and we bend ourselves out of shape to hide from what we think will hurt us.

It’s a unique and outstanding person who leans into danger and fear and continues forward.

I can’t think of a better example of that than our first responders, who once again leapt to our rescue and protected their neighbors despite the risk. Many lost their lives to save complete strangers.

**They are the best of us, and we owe them our thanks every day — but especially today.**

In the middle of this election I couldn’t let this opportunity pass without honoring the people that protect us every day. While we debate the policies that we believe will make Georgia a better, safer place to live, these heroes work every day to make that happen.

On behalf of myself, my campaign, and my community — thank you for your bravery and service.

More soon,
Rev. Darrius Butler

# Craig’s Campaign Updates
---
| With less than 2 weeks left until the election I wanted to update everyone about what we are doing and how we are doing on the trail. Although I was fortunate enough to not have an opponent in the primary or general election, I wanted to spend this time connecting with voters and learning about issues that we will be working on in the state house for the upcoming session. I recently met with concerned leaders in Lafayette to discuss the impact of the LEAP District in their area and hear out concerns involving property taxes.
---
|
---
| I drove up to Fowler in Benton County recently to meet with local leaders including hopeful commissioner elect John Gick about the importance in farming and how it is a national security issue to have our food supply secured with farmers like John. As your State Representative, I will fight for all farmers and ensure we can provide the resources they need to succeed in our state.
---
|
---
| Finally with the winds of autumn gearing up and our final warm days leaving us, the team and I had one last parade in my home county of Morgan County for their annual Fall Foliage Festival in Martinsville. I enjoyed dusting off the jet and playing Danger Zone one last time before we park it for the winter while having the opportunity to meet with families and my fellow Republicans in the county.
---
|
---
| Make sure to check out our website and follow our social media below because I think our work is just getting started and I look forward to having your support for the future.
---

### [Judicial Watch sues Oregon to force state to remove ineligible voters from voter rolls ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70859&L=33762&F=H&&hash=e15440402ce22cedd0d19e915ca506c3be13bf93f1a9ab6e51268c9184282d86) Just the News Conservative watchdog Judicial Watch on Wednesday announced a lawsuit against the state of Oregon, that would force it to remove ineligible voters from its voter rolls, as mandated by the National Voter Registration Act.

The voting act requires states to make a “reasonable effort” to remove voters who have either died or changed residences from their voter rolls. The voters are removed if they fail to respond to address confirmation notices, and do not vote in two consecutive federal general elections. The voting act requires states to make a “reasonable effort” to remove voters who have either died or changed residences from their voter rolls. The voters are removed if they fail to respond to address confirmation notices, and do not vote in two consecutive federal general elections. – Let me remind you: In 2018, Ted Cruz won by just **214,921** votes.
– In the six years since, **2.6 million** Texans have registered to vote.
Now, Cruz and I are deadlocked in the polls, so here it is: **If we can reach more newly registered voters than he can in these last few days, we'll be in the best position to win.**
That's where you come in, Derek: **[Will you chip in $10 or more between me and John Fetterman to help reach my $500,000 daily goal by midnight so we can take advantage of our best chance EVER at firing Ted Cruz?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-em20241028?refcode=em20241028-9529&refcode2=9529_434096_zIYzSh&akid=9529%2E434096%2EzIYzSh)**

name: Barbara Lee
subject: Passing the baton
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lateefah for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/leeandsimon?refcode=x_102824_barbaralee_actrs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/leeandsimon?refcode=x_102824_barbaralee_actrs]
Congresswoman Barbara Lee here.
I have had the honor of serving the people of California's 12th Congressional District for 26 years.
Throughout my tenure, I have had the privilege of working alongside incredible individuals who share my commitment to justice, equity, and opportunity for all — one of those people is Lateefah Simon.
Not only is Lateefah a dedicated advocate for justice and equality, but she’s also someone I hold in the highest regard. I’m proud to endorse her campaign to represent California’s 12th Congressional District.
Would you join me in supporting her campaign before her last end-of-month deadline of the cycle by splitting a contribution between Lateefah and myself? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/leeandsimon?refcode=x_102824_barbaralee_actrs]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/leeandsimon?refcode=x_102824_barbaralee_actrs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/leeandsimon?refcode=x_102824_barbaralee_actrs]
I first met Lateefah Simon when I was her professor at Mills College. Even then, it was clear that she was destined for greatness. She is a true fighter for peace and justice — from the community and for the community. Her dedication spans decades, from her early years supporting young women and trans youth to her advocacy for more affordable and accessible public transit.
Lateefah is a fierce advocate and proven leader, always working tirelessly to uplift those around her.
As we face political chaos from right-wing extremists, we need bold, trailblazing leadership that is unyielding in its commitment to equity and progress. Lateefah Simon embodies this leadership.
That’s why I have passed her the baton, quite literally. As I reflect on my journey, I see many valuable qualities in her that guided me.
And I see no one better suited to carry forward my work of uplifting the voices of the underrepresented, fighting for justice, and championing the East Bay’s needs.
With Lateefah in the House, we will deliver the progressive change our community and California deserve. So, Friend, Lateefah’s last end-of-month deadline is this Thursday. Can I count on you to support Lateefah’s campaign by splitting a donation between Lateefah and myself today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/leeandsimon?refcode=x_102824_barbaralee_actrs]
Let's build a future where everyone has a fair shot, and no one is left behind.
Thank you,
Barbara Lee
*Funds raised by Barbara Lee for the U.S. Senate will be used to retire outstanding campaign debt.*

| | Fellow American, I got a few free minutes today, with no meetings and calls. It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life.I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you. The truth is, when I jumped into this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-party state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates. But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in _burning_ our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. This is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help, we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S. **The last end of month deadline before Election Day is right around the corner.** We outraised Adam Schiff in past months but Kamala Harris’ nomination as the Democrat’s candidate for president has energized their grassroots supporters and donors. If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians, and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We **need** to show our strength this month. So, please: **[Can you make a $6 contribution to my campaign today?](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=07c0ba56c08d4b628bdf9b32a503cfed&_e=HbeYsbwwiG70-9fw4RLFLyvLNKYoRdYuuRxx0S3Qg0H1G7VdXKMOh6twZqXnzw6e6_en7uw_XC6PAx-g3oG2DE_mtePEIHuodKNSSKPiCH1o-mgwZPU_GKCfxOxdaObJ2bfVmYYyT4IKVOq557PveW7Nx0PIqXts_sc_LXq25zruDRsgTHn-yzkr7IgwI43uSb1LFNgK17ULFJBXyENU7-OUExPDUOnuBD_-ZNxNmZgBXDt647_IJaxGSMT8L3yw9O7tqSviCwhI5C_FD1je7AFRGvJH8q4Ncs0DKxVW0sdcohpcfsZ2vTFZFm9LLlqC-GS7JeXfhU45k1uZ-OsmXOASlzG0ip7XIfEwEVow0hBeFXJA-ZKhoQbsKJ5wyvylEtFACMTkXxsbg18NurmUkA%3D%3D) The amount really isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. clean_body: I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you. | | | It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life. | | | | Fellow American, I got a few free minutes today, with no meetings and calls. It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life.I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you. The truth is, when I jumped into this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-party state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates. But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. This is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help, we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S. The last end of month deadline before Election Day is right around the corner. We outraised Adam Schiff in past months but Kamala Harris’ nomination as the Democrat’s candidate for president has energized their grassroots supporters and donors. If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians, and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show our strength this month. So, please: The amount really isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. body:
I know my team and I have reached out a lot to ask for your financial support, not only for my campaign, but for Senate campaigns across the country. Thank you for any amount you've been able to send.

**[With early voting having started in every must-win state, today I want to update you on how your donations are being used.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/GkzqYehhay4FxupCLoZZHA~~/AARclAA~)**

**[--> In Pennsylvania,](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/GkzqYehhay4FxupCLoZZHA~~/AARclAA~) **small dollar donations are helping Dave McCormick and his team chase absentee ballots

**[--> In Michigan,](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/GkzqYehhay4FxupCLoZZHA~~/AARclAA~) **your support is a big reason why Mike Rogers has pulled even in the polls, despite being massively outspent heading into early voting

**[--> In Wisconsin,](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/GkzqYehhay4FxupCLoZZHA~~/AARclAA~)** Eric Hovde has made his Senate race a toss-up, thanks in part to small dollar donations fueling his Get Out The Vote program

**[--> And in Ohio,](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/GkzqYehhay4FxupCLoZZHA~~/AARclAA~)** Bernie Moreno's ads, sponsored by tough conservatives like you, are setting the record straight about Sherrod Brown's liberal record

**[Whatever state you live in, if you haven't already voted, I hope you'll make a plan to do so as soon as you can.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/GkzqYehhay4FxupCLoZZHA~~/AARclAA~)** This election is going to be as close as it gets.

**[If you haven't pitched in this month, I hope you'll read more about why these Senate campaigns, and others, need your support over the next two weeks.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/GkzqYehhay4FxupCLoZZHA~~/AARclAA~)**

Together, let's save our country.

In service,

A series of sprints add up to a marathon. Being successful in these 2024 elections could help lay the foundation for an even fairer redistricting process in 2031. The fate of these races could have a direct outcome on upcoming redistricting — and the effort we make between now and next Tuesday could determine countless people’s ability to make their voices heard in our democracy.

We get it — and so we want to cut to the chase and give you the facts about why these elections urgently need your attention right now. name: Team GIFFORDS
subject: Phone Bank with Gabby Giffords and Congresswoman McBath!
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Sign up for our upcoming phone bank to support gun safety.
#

Friend,
We're excited to invite you to a special phone bank event!
**Join us on[Friday, November 1, at 6 pm ET/3 pm PT](https://go.giffords.org/go/58003?t=1&akid=9317%2E3935704%2E5mC941) for the Gun Violence Prevention Voters for Harris-Walz Phone Bank.**
This is a unique opportunity to hear from former Congresswoman **Gabby Giffords** and Congresswoman **Lucy McBath** from Georgia, two women who have had their lives turned upside down by gun violence. Your voice matters in this fight, and this event is a powerful way to connect with others who are dedicated to preventing gun violence.
**[RSVP](https://go.giffords.org/go/58002?t=2&akid=9317%2E3935704%2E5mC941)**
Thank you for your commitment as a responsible gun owner to this important cause—**together, we can make a difference!**
We hope you’ll join us on November 1.
In solidarity,
The team at GIFFORDS
PS: Help us spread the message online—use this [**Social Media Toolkit**](https://go.giffords.org/go/57507?t=3&akid=9317%2E3935704%2E5mC941) to share how Team Harris-Walz is fighting to make our communities safer. Your voice can inspire others to join the cause!

Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=4&akid=9317%2E3935704%2E5mC941) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

name: Evangelicals for Harris
subject: Vote. Share. Pray.
body:
Help Others Vote | |
---
| | | As evangelical Christians, we care deeply about our Christian witness in all we do. Which is why **_our votes for Harris and Walz are so important, because they represent a witness to our Christian faith which prioritizes loving our neighbors and having compassion for the most vulnerable among us._**

If you've already voted - thank you! This is a turnout election and also one that will be won at the margins. With eight days to go and early voting well underway, **_two of the most important things you can do now, in addition to casting your own vote, are to share your vote for Harris/Walz with families, friends, and communities and help them vote_**. Here are some suggestions.
1. **Share your vote for Harris/Walz with friends, families and networks and ask them to vote for Harris/Walz – in your conversations, and on social media.** Share why your faith led you to this vote. Tag your friends, families and networks, especially those in battleground states (MI, PA, WI, NC, AZ, NV, GA, NE);
2. **Watch and share Evangelicals for Harris ads including our newest ****“[Hope For Harris Video Series](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=90836b761f&e=43463f1dee)**” with leaders and regular folk telling their stories of support for Harris;
3. **Watch and share [Rural Evangelicals for Harris supporter call highlights](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=abbeb23ecb&e=43463f1dee)**, with Harris policies that will help rural families and communities;
4. Watch and share our recent videos endorsing Harris by **former Republican House members ****[Bob Inglis](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=434a970bae&e=43463f1dee)**** (R-SC) and [Adam Kinzinger](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=a2ae0a84b2&e=43463f1dee)**** (R-IL);**
5. Share Evangelicals for Harris [resources to help your friends and family vote](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=35d92b99e9&e=43463f1dee);
6. **Help your families and friends vote. **Offer to watch the kids, or drive them to the polls. Every act of kindness and support helps because every vote matters.

**For those who wish to do more, please see opportunities below for critical volunteer roles, both virtually and across the battleground states \- including bilingual help,** from the Harris campaign. We encourage you to prayerfully consider these. Training will be provided for all roles and you do not need to be a lawyer to participate.

**_“Let’s not get tired of doing good, because in time we’ll have a harvest if we don’t give up.” (Galatians 6:9)_**

Thank you for all you’re doing. We’re praying for you.

Blessings,
The Evangelicals for Harris Team

Poll Monitors: Monitor and report on activity at voting locations

Cure Volunteers
Help voters fix mail ballot mistakes to make sure their votes count -now and right after Election Day.

➡ AZ: [https://lnkd.in/e8nRG3Sb](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=0f88dd62a2&e=43463f1dee)

name: Jill Stein for President
subject: Kamala throws migrants and trans people under the bus
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
She’s moving even further right!

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter, As the election draws closer, Kamala Harris is shifting even further right. Last week, in addition to dismissing voters who say that genocide is a red line for them by pivoting to the price of groceries (which has gone through the roof under the Biden-Harris administration) she also reaffirmed her commitment to building a border wall and refused to commit to allowing all transgender Americans access to gender-affirming healthcare.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_10_28_pm&n=1)
---
At her CNN Town Hall, Anderson Cooper noted that Kamala had once called Trump’s plan to build a border wall “stupid”, “useless”, and “a medieval vanity project”, and pressed her on whether or not she now was in favor of building the wall; Kamala’s response was to mock Trump for NOT successfully building the wall, and she declared that she’s “not afraid of good ideas where they occur”, signaling that she’s willing to continue Trump’s most draconian far-right immigration policies. Last week Kamala sat down for an interview with NBC’s Hallie Jackson who asked if she believes that transgender Americans should have access to gender affirming care; her response to what should have been a simple yes or no question quickly descended into one of Kamala’s signature incoherent word salad answers. What _was_ clear is that Kamala has no serious commitment to basic trans rights when she coldly responded: “I believe we should follow the law.” In other words, the right to medically transition would be left up to the states, and if you’re a transgender person in a state that has stripped you of this basic right, well, you better follow the law. From traveling around the country with far right Republican, Liz Cheney, to her breathless compliments of Liz’s father, notorious war criminal Dick Cheney, to touting her support from over 200 prominent Republicans, Kamala’s been selling herself as a special kind of Democrat – the kind of Democrat whose main concern is appeasing Republicans! [_**Peter, as we go into the final week, the American people need to know that they don’t have to choose between blue fascism or red fascism, but instead can cast their vote for Green empowerment with Jill and Butch. Can you give whatever you can, $2.40, $24.00 or more today to make sure that we can get the word out everywhere through ads and digital billboards at this crucial moment?**_](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_10_28_pm&n=2)
---

---
We deserve a President who will end genocide, treat migrants with dignity and respect, and allow our transgender siblings their fundamental right to be able to make decisions about what to do with their own bodies in peace. We deserve President Jill Stein.**** Thank you for your support. Together we’re going to shock the world and turn the White House into a Green House.**** In solidarity and gratitude,

body:

---
| | Good afternoon,

We have less than a week until November 5th – Election Day. That’s right: the election is almost here!

It is crazy how my supporters from outside of my district from Snowflake down to Tucson are seeing the liberal attack ads against me and paid for by out-of-state special interest unions on their cable TV shows and streaming services.

Thankfully, I have been working hard and smart through a contested primary right into this contentious general election. Most people who know me know I have been giving it my all to save our beautiful state and its current offerings from the time I was appointed in July 2023. When I was recruited back to the Capitol and then appointed to fill this vacancy, I said if I was appointed, I would run for this seat. It has been grueling.

Each day Team Bolick continues to hit the pavement across Legislative District 2. I am still _slightly_ handicapped with a walking boot on my right foot, but I am still meeting with voters daily, but not as quickly as I’d like. Thankfully, we have had quite a few “pinch runners” come into our district to help me cover much needed ground after I injured my right foot back in early September.

While I don’t have the big bucks like the national Democrats do, our team from inside our state have been hard at work. The national Democrat donor class, Jane Fonda and her ilk from woke Hollywood, their out-of-state special interest groups, and straw donors through ActBlue by disguising illegal political donations have collectively reported spending **more than $1.825 million dollars **attacking me – all for a “part-time” job with a $24,000/year salary.

It’s all about power and control over you and your family for the Democrats. The leftwing radical Democrats don’t care about average everyday Arizonans like you struggling to make ends meet or trying to keep food on the table or gas in their gas taking to get to work. My own leftwing opponent even said on the House floor in 2023 that she wanted to "[cap your income](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=707660d1db&e=a7ab36849c)." (Click on "cap your income." Then, scroll down and click on the arrow button to watch and listen for yourself)

It has become more commonplace to encounter some of the out-of-state paid liberal canvassers from Chicago or Los Angeles while we are crisscrossing the district. Apparently, these out-of-state canvassers don’t like Arizona's heat, but they like the money and the reimbursement of their expenses enough to campaign here to take away our freedoms and liberties. You should see some of their paid canvassers that want to turn Arizona into California. They are wearing their lanyards to identify who they represent. (First clue: not us!) But these big Chicago union lackeys are donning sun hats, face masks, long-sleeved shirts and long pants to shield themselves from Arizona’s blazing sun.

If you would like to [donate](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=c75e82b9bb&e=a7ab36849c) to our campaign to further slay Goliath in our last full week, you can donate online to hep us refuel into our home stretch.

On the ground, voters are fired up to vote. I remind them once they return their early mail ballots most of the direct mail and text messages they are currently receiving will come to a stop. Many other voters we have encountered the past few days still want to vote on Election Day, but are greatly appreciative of the educational election information we hand them to help them vote in local, state, and federal races, judges, propositions, and more.

If you live in Legislative District 2 and have yet to vote, this is [our golden ticket](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=fa32c4cbdc&e=a7ab36849c) we have been sharing with voters. I am currently an associate member of the Palo Verde Republican Women’s Club and I like their [“cheat sheet”](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=0bc73b6904&e=a7ab36849c) for our state’s ballot propositions along with brief explanations so they are receiving this piece of paper as well.

[I voted last Thursday](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=fca9497946&e=a7ab36849c) in-person at the polling location at ASU-West. Please make a plan to vote. If you live in Maricopa County, find the nearest open polling location to you [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=75fdbca6ea&e=a7ab36849c). Your liberties and freedoms are on the November 5th ballot. Please join me in voting early and in-person. If you are voting by mail, today is the last day you can mail it with the hope it will arrive before November 5th according to the local recorder’s office website. Once you have physically voted your ballot, you can track your ballot [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=896ebeb21b&e=a7ab36849c).

_Remember:_ I have a proven track record of services to Arizona families and taxpayers.
**I voted to protect Arizona’s border and punish fentanyl dealers. **
**I have continued to fight for parental rights and educational freedom.**
**I will continue to support tax relief for middle-class families and small businesses by voting for pro-growth policies.**

Thank you for your continued support!

Take care,
Shawnna

| | | | | Peter,

🚨 **BREAKING —** A coalition of landlords across North Dakota has come together to announce that they **will reduce rent for their tenants** when Measure 4 passes!
_"If Measure 4 passes, the savings will be significant. We as landlords are committed to making sure our tenants feel some of that relief. Lower property taxes mean lower rent, and lower rent means tenants that are struggling will have more money in their pocket.” ****_**-Lee Gierszewski, Clooski Properties, BumpMG properties** _

“The savings from Measure 4 are significant. By eliminating property taxes, we can directly pass those savings to renters, and we encourage other property owners to do the same. This will make housing more affordable throughout North Dakota, benefiting everyone involved.”**-**_**Jason Frank, Sundancer Properties**
This will impact **over 7,000 units in several cities** , bringing much-needed financial relief to renters.

These landlords are committed to ensuring that the economic benefits of Measure 4 reach as many North Dakotans as possible.

By cutting property taxes, Measure 4 will allow landlords to pass their savings onto their tenants — putting money back into the pockets of hardworking families.

This pledge puts pressure on all other landlords to follow suit and ensure their tenants see the same benefits.

**We’ve always known that Measure 4 is a game-changer** , but this commitment from our apartment community shows just how wide-reaching its impact will be.

The renters of these apartments, townhomes, and storage facilities will see their rent decrease and receive a direct financial benefit from the passage of Measure #4.

Lower taxes mean more affordable living, and that’s something we can all get behind.

**Vote** _**YES**_**on Measure 4! ✅**

# **RITE Files Amicus Brief in United States Supreme Court to Support Virginia’s Right to Remove Noncitizens from its Voter Rolls **

(Washington, D.C. – October 28, 2024) - Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (“RITE”), a non-profit organization that supports litigation to protect election security and integrity, today [filed an amicus brief](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=3f112bc260&e=ea91f782ea), or a “friend of the court” brief, in the United States Supreme Court in support of the Commonwealth of Virginia’s effort to remove self-identified noncitizens from its voter rolls.

Recently, under the direction of Governor Glenn Youngkin, the Commonwealth of Virginia has taken steps to remove self-identified noncitizens from its voter rolls. Activist groups and the Biden-Harris administration’s Department of Justice sued Virginia officials to stop the state from cleaning up its voter rolls, claiming that Virginia’s practice violates federal law’s prohibition of certain systematic programs to remove voters close to an election.

“When people tell the Commonwealth of Virginia that they are not citizens—Virginia should be able to believe him,” said Derek Lyons, President of RITE. “The federal government’s efforts to compel Virginia to expose its elections to non-citizen participation is an abuse of authority. The Supreme Court must step in to put an end to this assault on commonsense and on the integrity of our elections.”

Wisconsin’s statewide Fundraising Reporting Deadline is in 14 hours.
Our team set a fundraising goal that we need to reach in order to maximize our voter outreach efforts in the last 16 days before the Election, and we're just $2,293 shy of reaching it.

This is not a toy, or a gimmicky product that will only produce a sound of 250 million volts, IT IS A **[ELECTROCUTION SELF-DEFENSE WEAPON](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/18928/6374453/091507358aa7f0895f72823a6fd96a69bb9d628d/5731743f9bcd76466762394696f6901f461881e3)** and will absolutely take an attacker down.

In 2021, I graduated from Stanford with a computer science degree and shortly after, I decided to study law at Georgetown. But after experience working in tech and law, I quickly understood it wasn’t enough for me. You see, Peter, I wanted to do something where I could give back to the community that raised me. I began to feel the call to public service. And when I realized the State Senator representing my hometown, Shawn Still, was one of Donald Trump’s fake electors, I knew I had seen enough. It was then that I decided to run for State Senate. Fast forward to now, us Democrats are closer than ever to flipping District 48’s seat. According to recent polling data, Shawn Still holds a 1% margin over us, which puts us in a favorable position to pull ahead come Election Day. [But in order to do so, Peter, I'll need your help. If you can pitch in just $10 between my campaign and Blue Amp Action, we can get one step closer to flipping this seat Blue.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T883d20d4-e17a-426d-a5ee-ce50a2b3e742/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Whether your donations are used to provide food for volunteers, spend money on ads, or put up lawn signs, I can assure that your support will be put to good use. body:
The frontlines of the fight for abortion rights: |
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96017181/508634019/162262288?refcode=WTEFEV96_20241028_SumpremeCourtRU_ALL_v1s4&sourceid=1055273&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NTQxYTg0Ny02ODk1LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WOISv-EiNRrapzF9M0FtBQNvS2YJOMDGYr4rqjBvvQc=) Peter — In many states, access to abortion could come down to a single decision by the state Supreme Court.

That's why EMILYs List is proud to endorse four pro-choice champions running for state Supreme Court seats this cycle:**Justice Kyra Harris Bolden (MI), Kimberly Thomas (MI), Judge Christine Weems (TX) and Justice Allison Riggs (NC)**.**** These women could make critical decisions around abortion rights for more than _50 million people._ [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96017182/508634021/162262288?refcode=WTEFEV96_20241028_SumpremeCourtRU_ALL_v1s4&sourceid=1055273&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NTQxYTg0Ny02ODk1LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WOISv-EiNRrapzF9M0FtBQNvS2YJOMDGYr4rqjBvvQc=) [**Will you chip in to support candidates up and down the ballot who can PROTECT abortion rights?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96017183/508634022/162262288?refcode=WTEFEV96_20241028_SumpremeCourtRU_ALL_v1s4&sourceid=1055273&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NTQxYTg0Ny02ODk1LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WOISv-EiNRrapzF9M0FtBQNvS2YJOMDGYr4rqjBvvQc=) | [DONATE](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96017184/508634023/162262288?refcode=WTEFEV96_20241028_SumpremeCourtRU_ALL_v1s4&sourceid=1055273&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NTQxYTg0Ny02ODk1LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WOISv-EiNRrapzF9M0FtBQNvS2YJOMDGYr4rqjBvvQc=)

Last year, we endorsed our first-ever state Supreme Court candidate: **Justice Janet Protasiewicz** from Wisconsin. She won, flipping the balance of the Court from conservative to liberal. Now, we're ready to build on that success:
* **Justice Kyra Harris Bolden (MI),** the first Black woman to sit on the Michigan Supreme Court, has demonstrated her commitment to fairly interpreting the law and protecting the rights of Michiganders. Liberals currently hold a narrow _one-seat majority_ on this Court, so it’s essential that Justice Harris Bolden keeps this seat.

* **Kimberly Thomas (MI)** has spent her life pursuing justice for lower-income communities and is now running to FLIP a conservative-held seat on the Michigan Supreme Court, which would ensure a safe liberal majority.

* **Justice Allison Riggs (NC)** has spent her entire career advocating for equal justice in North Carolina, and we know she has what it takes to beat her anti-choice opponent. Conservatives currently hold a 5-2 majority in the North Carolina Supreme Court, so we've got to hold this seat if we want a chance at flipping the Court in future years.

* **Judge Christine Weems (TX)** is a proven advocate for justice and is committed to defending the rights of all Texans, especially the right to safe and legal abortion. She's challenging incumbent anti-choice extremist Justice John Devine, who was part of the extremist majority who _last year_ denied a Texas woman an emergency abortion when her life was at risk.

**It's never been more important to have pro-choice justices on our highest courts.** With Republican lawmakers passing an increasing number of abortion bans from coast to coast, state Supreme Courts will play a pivotal role in determining whether our reproductive freedoms are protected.

clean_body: The frontlines of the fight for abortion rights: | = Peter — In many states, access to abortion could come down to a single decision by the state Supreme Court. That's why EMILYs List is proud to endorse four pro-choice champions running for state Supreme Court seats this cycle:Justice Kyra Harris Bolden (MI), Kimberly Thomas (MI), Judge Christine Weems (TX) and Justice Allison Riggs (NC).** These women could make critical decisions around abortion rights for more than 50 million people. = = | = Last year, we endorsed our first-ever state Supreme Court candidate: Justice Janet Protasiewicz from Wisconsin. She won, flipping the balance of the Court from conservative to liberal. Now, we're ready to build on that success: Justice Kyra Harris Bolden (MI), the first Black woman to sit on the Michigan Supreme Court, has demonstrated her commitment to fairly interpreting the law and protecting the rights of Michiganders. Liberals currently hold a narrow one-seat majority on this Court, so it’s essential that Justice Harris Bolden keeps this seat. Kimberly Thomas (MI) has spent her life pursuing justice for lower-income communities and is now running to FLIP a conservative-held seat on the Michigan Supreme Court, which would ensure a safe liberal majority. Justice Allison Riggs (NC) has spent her entire career advocating for equal justice in North Carolina, and we know she has what it takes to beat her anti-choice opponent. Conservatives currently hold a 5-2 majority in the North Carolina Supreme Court, so we've got to hold this seat if we want a chance at flipping the Court in future years. Judge Christine Weems (TX) is a proven advocate for justice and is committed to defending the rights of all Texans, especially the right to safe and legal abortion. She's challenging incumbent anti-choice extremist Justice John Devine, who was part of the extremist majority who last year denied a Texas woman an emergency abortion when her life was at risk. It's never been more important to have pro-choice justices on our highest courts.** With Republican lawmakers passing an increasing number of abortion bans from coast to coast, state Supreme Courts will play a pivotal role in determining whether our reproductive freedoms are protected. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thank you, Sarah Curmi (she/her/hers) Vice President of State and Local Campaigns, EMILYs List = = Thank you for being a supporter of EMILYs List. Peter -- **Join us for a fun night watching the election results together at the OKGOP Election Night Watch Party!**
### When: Tuesday, November 5th
Starting: 6:00 pm
Where: Champion Convention Center \-
(Behind the Hilton Garden Inn Hotel)
737 S Meridian Ave, Oklahoma City, OK 73108

Welcome to the **OKGOP Election Night Watch Party**! Join us on **Tuesday, Nov. 5, 2024** at **6:00 PM** at the **Champion Convention Center** for a night of excitement and anticipation as we watch the election results roll in. Come mingle with fellow party members, enjoy the live band, and cheer on your favorite candidates. The Republican Women's Club of Central Oklahoma will be doing a 50/50 drawing and there will be door prizes. There will be a hot dog vendor and cash bar, as well several Elected Officials will be there to make brief remarks. It's going to be a night to remember, so don't miss out!

subject: Trump’s hate-filled rally at Madison Square Garden
disclaimer_text:
PAID FOR BY
MONDAIRE FOR CONGRESS
body:
My opponent attended Donald Trump’s rally at Madison Square Garden with a lineup of neo-Nazis and other bigots.
Team,

Last night—as I was being interviewed about our race and what I’ll do to help New Yorkers—my opponent, Mike Lawler, attended Donald Trump’s rally at Madison Square Garden with a lineup of neo-Nazis and other bigots.

The rally was an absolute disgrace. It featured speakers who used sexist, racist, and antisemitic rhetoric that puts communities in danger.

Lawler has no regard for the New Yorkers harmed by this hateful rhetoric. His main concern is pleasing Donald Trump and supporting his extreme MAGA agenda.

name: Alaskans for Harris-Walz
subject: Reminder - "We Are Not Going Back" Benefit Concert featuring Zane Penny, Pamyua, and Emma Hill - New $10 Price Available for Virtual Attendees
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA016/1/102754/images/WebsiteFacebook%20banner%20%282%29.png]
Dear Friend,
Get your freedom-inspired poster designed by Natalie Treadwell for Tuesday’s “We Are Not Going Back” Benefit Concert. These collectors’ items will go to the first 100 ticket holders to arrive. Join us tomorrow night for an exciting evening in support of Alaskans for Harris-Walz on Tuesday, October 29th, from 6PM to 9PM at Williwaw Social in Anchorage!
The evening promises a vibrant mix of live music, community, and purpose, with headliner Zane Penny [https://www.instagram.com/zanepennymusic] , popular Alaska artists Phillip Blanchett of Pamyua [https://www.pamyua.com/] and songwriter Emma Hill [http://www.emmahillmusic.com/] performing, alongside surprise appearances from Harris-Walz campaign representatives to rally voters ahead of Election Day.
The window to get your tickets is closing! Individual tickets start at $25, and
(or $10 for virtual/Zoom) with larger contributions welcomed and group package options available.

Let us explain:
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96018544/508638746/1790176412?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzgyNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZDE1OWY2Ni02Yjk1LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5FkYLt3vTG5xI8adZj8XjjbYuZss7qwaA57W4QrRuXY=&emci=1e371e52-4995-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=ad159f66-6b95-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=23311593) | Peter,

This election comes down to a clear choice: Matt Cartwright, who’s always stood with the people of PA-08, or his extreme opponent, **who’s more interested in advancing his party’s agenda than doing what’s right for us.**

**Here’s the difference:**
* Matt fights for PA-08. Bresnahan? He’s ready to fall in line with whatever the GOP needs.
* While Matt stands for northeastern Pennsylvanian values, Bresnahan is more focused on scoring points with Washington insiders and advancing his own political career.
* Matt gets things done. Bresnahan just hopes to bring home a win to fall in favor of Republican Speaker Mike Johnson.

_Peter – there’s a reason even Rob Bresnahan donated to Matt’s re-election campaign back in 2022._
