_First the New York Times lied about my childhood and family, and now CNN is lying about my business record._

subject: Four names you need to know.
body:
One senator’s polling lead has “deteriorated” and another is facing millions of dollars in outside spending.

Bob Casey.
Ruben Gallego.
Jacky Rosen.** These are the names of Democrats whose Senate races _Cook Political Report_ has rated “Lean Democrat” for most of this election cycle. There is no path to defending our Senate majority without winning these races. In Tammy Baldwin’s race in Wisconsin, reports say that her lead in the polls has “deteriorated.” Bob Casey’s race in Pennsylvania is one of the most expensive in the country, with his Republican opponent pouring millions of his own dollars into the race. # FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Peter, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

clean_body: A gift to the American people For a limited time, join for just 1¢. | | | | FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ | | Dear Peter, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right. In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong. Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts. The New York Sun is different. It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party. Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point. When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments. The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate. It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism. I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join. The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth. But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today. Every person matters in this effort. Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now. | | | | | Alan Dershowitz Columnist for The New York Sun | | | | | Alan Dershowitz Columnist for The New York Sun | | |

body:
This campaign is facing a crucial moment.
#
Hi,
It’s Sal McBride — Sarah’s mom — and I wanted to share something from my heart today.
You know, watching your child grow up, you see all their little moments of courage add up to something remarkable. For Sarah, those moments have grown into a powerful mission to serve our state of neighbors.
Every time I see Sarah speaking with families in Delaware, I’m reminded of when she was young. Sarah was always the first to stand up for someone who needed help. That same spirit drives her today as she fights for better affordable housing and health care and good jobs.
What makes me most proud isn't just what Sarah has accomplished — watching her pass paid leave and her Protect Medicaid Act were certainly proud mom moments! It's how she's done it: by listening, by bringing people together, and by never backing down when our values are on the line.
**Today, this campaign is facing a crucial moment. Election Day is just over a week away, and Sarah needs our help to get her message out to every voter.**
[**That’s why I’m personally asking you: Can you support Sarah with a donation of $5 or whatever you can give today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241028-1?refcode=em20241028-1496&amount=5&refcode2=1496_21716_6ULz5u&akid=1496%2E21716%2E6ULz5u)

I am confident Sarah will bring the same dedication to Congress that she’s shown throughout her life. But she cannot do this alone. Your support today will help her continue fighting for the future our neighbors deserve.
Thank you for being part of Sarah’s journey. It means the world to our family.
With gratitude,
Sal McBride

Hi there, As I wrap up this incredible journey on the road here in beautiful Colorado, I wanted to personally reach out. It’s been an inspiring, intense, and unforgettable journey, hitting the ground for Vice President Kamala Harris and our JanePAC-endorsed candidates across the country. From rallies and canvass kickoffs to speaking with supporters one-on-one, every bit of this work has been about building momentum for climate action. I’ve been everywhere — Michigan, California, Arizona, New Mexico, Washington State, and now here in Colorado, the finish line of this road trip, just 8 days out from Election Day. Not bad for someone who’s been around the block a few times, right? It turns out that fighting for our planet keeps you young... and keeps you moving! It’s been an inspiring, intense, and unforgettable journey, hitting the ground for Vice President Kamala Harris and our JanePAC-endorsed candidates across the country. From rallies and canvass kickoffs to speaking with supporters one-on-one, every bit of this work has been about building momentum for climate action. I’ve been everywhere — Michigan, California, Arizona, New Mexico, Washington State, and now here in Colorado, the finish line of this road trip, just 8 days out from Election Day. Not bad for someone who’s been around the block a few times, right? It turns out that fighting for our planet keeps you young... and keeps you moving! I’ve had the honor of meeting supporters who believe in a future free from the grip of fossil fuel interests. body:
I *doughnut* know what I'd do without you 🍩
| | |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96019504/508641657/1820369458?amounts=10, 25,50,100,250&amount=10&refcode=jtk2396-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODk2YTMyMmYtNmU5NS1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=EY1xOBVGSCwJ-bAcNLiILedzpKRls5wU5FAJ3sHVMoE=)
Friend,

You probably didn’t wake up this morning and think, “ _Today's the day I’m going to make a $10 donation to DMP's campaign!_ ” — **but ahead of my critical end-of-month deadline, it's what I’m about to ask you to do.**
Unlike Rick Scott, I don't have a massive fortune at my campaign's disposal. I come from a working-class family, so I know my eye-watering **$10 million end-of-month goal** is nothing to shake a stick at. But it's the only way I'll be able to defeat him.
**_[If that's all you need to hear, please click here to chip in $10 now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96019505/508641658/1820369458?amounts=10, 25,50,100,250&amount=10&refcode=jtk2396-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODk2YTMyMmYtNmU5NS1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=EY1xOBVGSCwJ-bAcNLiILedzpKRls5wU5FAJ3sHVMoE=)_ **— **but I'd like to share what your hard-earned $10 means to me.**
See, my family moved to the US from Ecuador with big dreams for a better life when I was 14. But it didn't come easy, and despite my mom working back-to-back double shifts, we still struggled to afford rent on our one room apartment.
**So once I turned 15, I began taking early morning shifts at a doughnut shop before school.** It wasn't much, but the extra cash gave my family room to breathe, and eventually, the life we dreamt of finally came true.
But I'm not the only one who got their start in the doughnut business. When he was a young man, my opponent, Rick Scott, _**bought**_ two doughnut shops.

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: Jordan called in the Trump Train for backup!
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Our team is going full throttle as we head into the final 8 days of this race. We’re talking to every voter we can about our vision for Ohio: protecting Social Security, fighting for fair wages with no tax on overtime , and ensuring that affordable healthcare and housing are within reach for every person.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241028_trump_train_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241028_trump_train_image]
But just as we’re getting folks energized, we got wind that Trump’s campaign bus made a pit stop to try and save face for Jim Jordan.
Yes, you read that right! Jim Jordan is so rattled about this election that he’s begging for Trump to help him scrape up some votes.
The funniest part is, Trump wasn’t even there! But Jordan knows his campaign is in hot water, so here he is, whining and scrambling, hoping even the appearance of a visit from Trump can bail him out.
It’s honestly a little embarrassing!
Imagine calling in a guy who’s been indicted and convicted multiple times and asking him to try and save your job.
But desperate times call for desperate measures, right?
After 17 years in Congress without a single bill to his name, Jordan’s got little to show, so he’s bringing in his convict-in-chief to cover up that blank record.
In any other job, a record like that would be grounds for getting the boot. The rest of us hardworking Ohioans don’t get to skate by on years of failure.
But somehow, Jim Jordan thinks he’s the exception.
So here’s my big ask: we need your help to finish strong and outshine Jordan’s last-minute antics. Will you rush a contribution today to keep our ads on the air and our team on the ground, letting every voter know just how badly Jim Jordan has failed voters? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241028_trump_train_link1]
We’re in the final stretch of the most important congressional race in the country, and every dollar you give goes straight toward firing Jim Jordan once and for all.
Jordan’s desperation is showing, and voters are waking up.
With Trump’s help, he’ll probably spend the next week whining about “fake news” and pushing wild conspiracies, all in an attempt to distract from the fact that he’s done absolutely nothing for the country other than sew division.
Our team isn’t slowing down; we’re ready to counter his empty noise with real plans, real change, and a real vision for our future.
Ohioans deserve a representative who believes every person has the right to make choices about their own bodies, who will defend the right to vote without interference, and who knows the sacrifices our seniors and veterans made – and treats their benefits as sacred.
Jordan has voted time and again to dismantle these programs, leaving the most vulnerable out in the cold.
It’s our time to put an end to Jordan’s do-nothing political career and pave the way for leadership that actually cares about everyday people.
Will you join us in making history by contributing to our movement right now? Let’s make sure Jim Jordan’s panic isn’t enough to save him. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241028_trump_train_link2]
Thanks for standing with us every step of the way. With your support, we’re going to finish what we started and bring true representation to Washington
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson
PS: If you can join us making phone calls, knocking on doors, or a number of other things, please sign up ASAP here. [https://www.tamiewilson.com/volunteer/]

body:
I'm proud to be one of Kirsten's earliest believers
| | |
---
Friend, when I first met Kirsten Gillibrand, she was a young lawyer running for Congress in a district with more cows than Democrats.
Defeating a deeply entrenched GOP incumbent in a tough red district is no easy task. Truthfully, there weren't many people who thought she could pull it off. **But on election night in 2006, people everywhere learned to never — _ever_ — count Kirsten out.** (For the record, I'm proud to be one of her earliest believers.)
Since that first election, Kirsten has proven herself time and time again as a fierce, bold advocate for families around America. The minute she was sworn in as our junior senator, I gained an incredible partner. During our time serving in the Senate, we've worked together on countless pieces of legislation, secured millions in federal funding for vital social programs and proudly fought for progress as a united team.
**As Kirsten's colleague and friend —** _and as our Senate majority_** **_leader_**— take it from me: We need Kirsten's voice in the Senate.** But following a red wave in New York in 2022, Republicans are already targeting her seat for defeat.

As her final end-of-month deadline rapidly approaches, we need all hands on deck. That's why I'm personally reaching out. [Please, friend, will you donate $5 or more right now to help defend Kirsten's must-win seat? There are few people in Washington who work harder than Kirsten. She's expanded veterans' benefits, won justice for survivors of sexual abuse and cracked down on illegal gun trafficking. Together, we secured long overdue reforms to our military justice system — ensuring that our service members can seek justice without fear of retaliation. **Now, Kirsten is fighting to guarantee paid family leave for all Americans and** _**finally**_**add the Equal Rights Amendment to the Constitution.**
Kirsten is getting the job done — and Republicans are taking notice. They know how much of a threat Kirsten is to their far-right agenda. That's why they'll do everything within their power to defeat her.
New York Republicans celebrated their best election cycle in decades in 2022. Their extremist candidates flipped enough seats in the midterms to win control of the House. Now, they're trying to defeat Kirsten to take back the Senate too.
I know that Kirsten has what it takes to overcome the odds and defeat whichever radical right-wing extremist runs against her — she's done it before. But Kirsten is counting on grassroots support to take on the GOP.**[That's why I'm personally asking you to make a donation to Kirsten's campaign before midnight tonight. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 – and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: People are feeling hopeful about our future
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
There are so many reasons to feel hopeful.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20241028-4454-footer&t=1&akid=4454%2E420207%2Ebi4qPA)
Peter, as I’ve traveled to get out the vote in swing states across the country, I’ve noticed something: **People are feeling optimistic about our future.**
Now, the polls are still tight with just eight days to go — but we’re in a _much_ better position than we were earlier this year. And in this election, we have a chance to reject Donald Trump’s hateful MAGA movement once and for all.
On November 5th, we’ll make a choice about the kind of country we’re going to pass on to future generations. [**So Peter, will you pitch in $3 to help my campaign reach our $20,000 end-of-month goal and get out the vote?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241028-1?refcode=em20241028-4454amount=3&refcode2=4454_420207_bi4qPA&akid=4454%2E420207%2Ebi4qPA)
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241028-1?amount=3&refcode=em20241028-4454&refcode2=4454_420207_bi4qPA&akid=4454%2E420207%2Ebi4qPA)**
Working people deserve an administration and a Congress that prioritizes their needs above the whims of billionaires like Elon Musk. That’s why I’m working so hard to help Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats in tough races all over.
Because if we win, we’ll have an opportunity to do so much good: expanding Medicare to cover in-home care, restoring and protecting abortion rights, paid family and medical leave, and so much more.
There are so many reasons to be hopeful about the future. **But we still have eight days of hard work ahead of us** , and my whole team and I are counting on your grassroots support to keep us going!
[**Peter, if you’re as optimistic as I am and you’re ready to turn the page toward a more progressive future, will you pitch in $3 today? # FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
October 28, 2024
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

**ICYMI: Terra Lawson-Remer’s Long History of Being Lax with Criminals and Sex Offenders**
Another damning article from the San Diego News Desk that exposes Terra Lawson-Remer’s troubling record on crime. This comes after coddling up to supporters of theDefund The Police movement and accepting their contributions.
The article details her opposition to accountability measures, including Prop 36, and her past advocacy for the privacy of violent sexual predators. These actions reflect a pattern of leniency, raising concerns about her leadership and her seriousness to tackling rising crime.
Read the full article [here](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=e97c163273&e=784f78234b).
[**SD NEWS DESK: Terra Lawson-Remer’s Long History of Being Lax with Criminals and Sex Offenders**](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=d26f55ca5f&e=784f78234b)
San Diego County Supervisor Terra Lawson-Remer has long been criticized for her lenient stance on crime, a record that has come under increasing scrutiny as California grapples with a rise in smash-and-grab robberies, homelessness, and violent crime. Despite widespread support from both sides of the aisle for Prop 36, a measure that would put an end to rampant smash-and-grab robberies across the state, Lawson-Remer has refused to support the initiative. Prop 36, backed by a broad bipartisan coalition and more than a million signatures from voters across California, aims to restore accountability by addressing the surge in theft crimes that has paralyzed businesses and put community safety at risk.
Prop 36’s momentum has been driven by California residents’ frustration with the rise of crime. The initiative is not just about increased penalties but also about giving judges the ability to offer treatment programs for those struggling with addiction or mental health issues, something that Lawson-Remer claims to support. Yet, her refusal to back this widely supported measure leaves many questioning whether she truly prioritizes public safety.
This is not the first time Lawson-Remer has been at odds with common-sense criminal justice reforms. In 2021, she openly advocated for the privacy rights of violent sexual predators going so far as to oppose California Senate Bill 248, which required hearings for sexually violent predators to be open to the public. SB248 was designed to ensure transparency in the judicial process and give communities the ability to understand who was being considered for release back into their neighborhoods. Lawson-Remer called the bill “redundant” and argued for “flexibility” to protect the privacy of offenders in treatment options, a stance that put her squarely at odds with community members and victims’ rights advocates.
Her opposition to SB 248 was met with outrage from concerned parents and public safety advocates. Many pointed out that while protecting the privacy of violent sexual predators, Lawson-Remer failed to consider the safety and well-being of the communities where these predators could return. Critics argue that her position reflects a dangerous pattern—prioritizing the rights of criminals over the safety and security of law-abiding citizens.
In addition to her stance on sexual predators, Lawson-Remer’s record includes other decisions that raised eyebrows among voters concerned with public safety. In January 2021, she voted to support a controversial needle exchange program aimed at reducing health risks for intravenous drug users. According to The San Diego Union-Tribune on January 27, 2021, “County supervisors on Tuesday agreed to create a needle exchange program as part of a strategy to reduce health risks for intravenous drug users.” While proponents argue that such programs reduce the spread of diseases like HIV, critics contend that these programs enable drug addiction and undermine efforts to reduce drug use and crime. One supervisor who voted against the program pointed out, “Giving out needles still has the appearance of promoting drug abuse,” stating he would rather see more efforts toward drug abuse prevention.
The need for effective drug addiction treatment is dire, especially in light of the alarming statistics showing 6,928 emergency room visits for drug overdoses in San Diego County in 2021. Yet, the county only has 70 drug addiction beds under contract, none of which are located within the city of San Diego. This glaring lack of resources underscores the inadequacy of Lawson-Remer’s approach to addressing the drug crisis.
With her track record, it’s no wonder that Lawson-Remer’s failure to support Prop 36 is seen as more of the same. Her history of leniency and prioritizing offenders’ privacy over public safety is out of step with the needs of San Diego County residents, who are growing increasingly concerned about rising crime rates and the lack of accountability for repeat offenders.
As the election season heats up, voters will be looking closely at Lawson-Remer’s record, and her consistent opposition to measures that would hold criminals accountable may well be a deciding factor. These questions remain: Is Lawson-Remer truly interested in protecting her constituents, or is she more concerned with defending the rights of those who harm them?——

subject: "Floating island of garbage"

body:
That's what they think about you
#
Did you see this?
What is so messed up, that I wish more people understood, is that the things that they do in Puerto Rico are a testing ground for the policies — and horrors — that they then unveil in working-class communities in the United States.
When you have some a-hole calling Puerto Rico ‘floating garbage’ — **know that that’s what they think about you**.
It’s what they think about anyone that makes less money than them.
It’s what they think about the people who serve them food in a restaurant.
It’s what they think about the people that fold their clothes in a store.
**What is trash is people thinking about other human beings that way**. The thing that gets me is that these people rely — their entire lives — on working-class people.
[And so we are fighting _every minute of the next 7 days_ to keep them away from the White House and our rights, homes, and livelihoods. | | Peter, I got a few free minutes today, with no meetings and calls. It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life.I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you. The truth is, when I jumped into this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-party state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates. But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in _burning_ our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. This is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help, we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S. **The last end of month deadline before Election Day is right around the corner.** We outraised Adam Schiff in past months but Kamala Harris’ nomination as the Democrat’s candidate for president has energized their grassroots supporters and donors. If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians, and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We **need** to show our strength this month. body:
| I hope you’ll sign up to help reach even more undecided voters.
---
[](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1142?refcode=kh_em_do_20241028_b18_jod_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&amount=47&amounts=47%252C75%252C100%252C250%252C500&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241028_b18_jod_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=1&akid=210%2E2563979%2ElKddgb)
Peter -- With just eight days left before Election Day, I wanted to give you a quick update on where things stand and what you can do to help. **As we’ve been saying since day one, this is an extremely close race and it's going to take every single one of us getting involved to win.** **[So, if you have a day, a few hours, or even a few minutes to spare, join us. Click here to find an upcoming Team Harris-Walz event that works for your schedule>>](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241028_b18_jod_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=2&akid=210%2E2563979%2ElKddgb)** | | [SIGN UP TODAY](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241028_b18_jod_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=3&akid=210%2E2563979%2ElKddgb)
---
* * *
**_State of the Race_**
Every single one of our top battleground states is polling within the margin of error. I've been doing campaigns for a very long time, and I have never seen all seven battlegrounds this close.
**_What these polls are telling us is that many people are still undecided._ Our job is to make sure we are talking to those voters about the choice they have in front of them and persuading them.**
The Vice President and Governor Walz will be traveling all across this country to talk to as many people as possible before they vote. While they’re out on the road, they’re counting on you to reach out to the folks on your contact list, in your neighborhood, and in your community. **[If everyone in your life is already turning out to vote, then I hope you’ll find a way to reach more undecided voters today.](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241028_b18_jod_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=4&akid=210%2E2563979%2ElKddgb)**
**_Early Vote_**
We are seeing really high turnout in the battleground states. Democrats are returning ballots at a higher rate than Republicans and women are outvoting men across the board.
**But Republicans are _also_ voting earlier than ever before. So, we can’t let our foot off the gas. We cannot let the other side outwork us in persuading and mobilizing voters.**
We know we have the best candidate -- and many people are already turning out to vote for her -- but without grassroots energy we could very easily find ourselves facing four more years of Donald Trump. A Donald Trump that is more extreme than ever before.
**_How You Can Help_**
I know politics is really hard. It’s tough to find time to get involved or to find the energy to talk to the people in your life about politics. But it is really important in an election this close.
**Right now, our campaign is looking for more supporters from Cresco to volunteer -- on the ground, on the phone, even on social media -- to help reach undecided voters in the final stretch of this race.**

clean_body: | I hope you’ll sign up to help reach even more undecided voters. Peter -- With just eight days left before Election Day, I wanted to give you a quick update on where things stand and what you can do to help. As we’ve been saying since day one, this is an extremely close race and it's going to take every single one of us getting involved to win. | | State of the Race Every single one of our top battleground states is polling within the margin of error. I've been doing campaigns for a very long time, and I have never seen all seven battlegrounds this close. What these polls are telling us is that many people are still undecided. Our job is to make sure we are talking to those voters about the choice they have in front of them and persuading them. The Vice President and Governor Walz will be traveling all across this country to talk to as many people as possible before they vote. While they’re out on the road, they’re counting on you to reach out to the folks on your contact list, in your neighborhood, and in your community. Early Vote We are seeing really high turnout in the battleground states. Democrats are returning ballots at a higher rate than Republicans and women are outvoting men across the board. But Republicans are also voting earlier than ever before. So, we can’t let our foot off the gas. We cannot let the other side outwork us in persuading and mobilizing voters. We know we have the best candidate -- and many people are already turning out to vote for her -- but without grassroots energy we could very easily find ourselves facing four more years of Donald Trump. A Donald Trump that is more extreme than ever before. How You Can Help I know politics is really hard. It’s tough to find time to get involved or to find the energy to talk to the people in your life about politics. But it is really important in an election this close. Right now, our campaign is looking for more supporters from Cresco to volunteer -- on the ground, on the phone, even on social media -- to help reach undecided voters in the final stretch of this race. | Let’s get after it, Jen Jen O'Malley Dillon Campaign Chair, Harris for President | | | | |

| | Across the country, the GOP is working overtime to make it harder to vote in an attempt to boost their chances to win elections. From removing drop boxes to closing polling places to mandating bogus hand counts designed to delay certification, the people's right to vote and have that vote count is under attack like never before. Donald Trump and his MAGA cronies are engineering a multipronged attack on our institutions and undermining democracy every chance they get. It's destructive, sows distrust in government, and sets a dangerous precedent for the future. **I'm doing everything I can to fight for our shared values in the face of these right-wing attacks, and I know you're right there with me.** Remember, we have a powerful tool to put an end to these attacks: our votes. We the people can win against the MAGA attempts to take away our rights by getting out the vote and making our voices heard in numbers too large to ignore! [**If you need more information on voting in this election, visit this link.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96025829/508659810/-1612268846?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTMyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYzI3MmQ3NS03Yjk1LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V1r9m155g9ZiSqB76PFK6sSezqtAFYC-szN3sxRrkz4=&emci=7e30a44e-7795-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=bc272d75-7b95-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=7731215) The ballot box is the beating heart of our democracy, and one of my top priorities is to pass the Freedom to Vote Act to ensure every American can freely and safely exercise their right to vote. I know you're with me in this fight because we know the right to vote is a democracy issue, not a political issue. I know you're with me in this fight because we know the right to vote is a democracy issue, not a political issue. Folks: Here at Team Stelson HQ, we’re racing against the clock to raise $100k for Janelle Stelson’s bid for Congress before Thursday at midnight. And the fact of the matter is, we’re behind where we should be right now. We’re a little stressed! But we’ll be real with you for a second: We know you’re getting a lot of emails asking for money this week from a lot of different candidates and politicians. So we wanted to take just a minute to explain why this deadline actually matters. ([If you hate Scott Perry or want to support a Democrat with strong values like Janelle, you can donate here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96026260/508661402/1696632892?amount=10&source=JS_EM_FR_102824_Convinced&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3MTMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmEyNjQ0ZGItN2M5NS1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=FZlVixzZ3igl1nFp5GXJy9uLESKwNgEuf1TFgS4-reA=) But if you need to be convinced, read on...) So what are the stakes?
In one of the reports released by the January 6th Committee, Perry’s name was mentioned twenty-two times. He’s spent the last two years dodging subpoenas for his involvement in the insurrection, AND he even had his phone confiscated by the FBI. He’s also in favor of a national abortion ban! Scott Perry is a slimy politician, and PA-10 deserves better. Period. Why does this deadline matter?
This deadline is a big deal because it’s the LAST big deadline before Election Day. It's a big deal because we’re just 8 days out from Election Day, and we can’t afford to take any risks. Hitting our goals and meeting our deadlines is more critical than ever — because every goal hit amps up our momentum and ensures Janelle has everything she needs to finally defeat Scott Perry. If MAGA dark money groups think Janelle looks vulnerable for even a second, they’re going to give Scott Perry _even more_ of their dirty dollars! [We can’t let that happen.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96026261/508661403/1696632892?amount=10&source=JS_EM_FR_102824_Convinced&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3MTMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmEyNjQ0ZGItN2M5NS1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=FZlVixzZ3igl1nFp5GXJy9uLESKwNgEuf1TFgS4-reA=) And where is my money going?
Your generous donation would help Janelle pay her staffers, help buy door knocking literature and bottles of water for volunteers. Your donation helps pay for the software we need to target the right voters so that Janelle can reach out and share her story. me.

me if you could read through it.

I want to outline our campaign's message to fill Maryland’s open U.S.
Senate seat. It hinges on 3 major components:

Power to the People

This campaign has never been about me,
Peter. It’s always been about
Marylanders, our families, and our communities.

And when Republican Larry Hogan entered the race putting our Democratic
Senate majority at risk, it became about the future of the entire country.

That’s why Republicans are pouring millions of dollars into this race. But
during the Democratic Primary, we proved that Maryland is won by the many,
not by the money.

We’ve never had limitless resources, million dollar checks, or shady dark
money super PACs pulling the strings. Instead, we built a grassroots
coalition of people in every corner of the state who stepped up to
volunteer, donate, and talk to their neighbors about our campaign.

Your time and your contributions were the driving force behind our primary
victory, and we need to continue building on that in order to win next
week.

Focus on the Issues that Matter

While Republicans are lining up to get behind Donald Trump and his
divisive MAGA agenda, we're focusing on the issues that matter most to
people — like protecting abortion rights, improving wages, and preserving
our democracy.

My Republican opponent Larry Hogan hopes Marylanders won’t remember that
as governor, he vetoed legislation that would have expanded access to
abortion care throughout the state.

He’s banking on Marylanders forgetting that he vetoed a $15 minimum wage
and legislation to benefit unions and workers.

He’s hoping Marylanders won’t realize that electing him means handing
control of the Senate over to extremists like Ted Cruz and Lindsey Graham.

On the issues that matter most, Hogan’s record speaks for itself: He’s all
wrong for Maryland, and he’ll say and do whatever he thinks will win him
this seat.

Make the Case for a Democratic Senate Majority

Here’s the truth,
Peter: There simply isn’t any
way Democrats maintain our razor-thin Senate majority if Larry Hogan wins
this open seat.

Mitch McConnell handpicked Hogan for this race because he sees Maryland as
his best chance to flip a seat, retake the majority, and enact his
far-right, anti-choice agenda.

If the GOP retakes the Senate, they'll have the power to pass a national
abortion ban, roll back environmental protections, undermine our
elections, and so much more.

Hogan has proven that he cannot be trusted to protect our reproductive
rights or put Maryland families first. Defending the Senate is the only
way to protect our freedoms, uplift working families, and preserve our
democracy.

We’ve got a winning message that’s resonating with voters,
Peter, and I need your support
to make sure everyone hears it. [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/33201?t=1012&amount=25&akid=3104%2E52803%2EjT3F9q ]Can I count on you to chip in $25 to

the state?

Fellow Patriot, I’m afraid we could be at the end of the road. **I don****’****t mean to be too negative, but Tim Kaine has a MASSIVE war chest, and I just don****’****t know if we can overcome it.** This is CAPT Hung Cao. I’m not a career politician like Tim Kaine. Friends,
Jim Jordan thinks he can silence everyone – from brave abuse survivors, to judges, and even me, his opponent.
Why?
Because he’s terrified of accountability.
He dodges questions, runs sham investigations to create noise, and flat-out refuses to debate.
Can you rush a donation of $25, $50, or even $100 to show Jim Jordan he can dodge a debate, but he can’t dodge the truth? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241028_silencing_critics_link1]
Just like Trump, Jordan believes in squashing dissent and silencing critics.
That’s why he pressured wrestlers who suffered sexual abuse under his watch to change their stories.
That’s why he’s attacking the daughter of a judge in Trump’s financial crimes trial.
It’s intimidation, chaos, and distraction – all tactics to hide his own failures and his dangerous priorities.
But here’s the thing: he’s awfully silent when it’s his turn to answer for his dismal record of 17 years of nothing in Congress.
This week since Jordan refused to debate me, I set up a podium and speakers outside his office in Ohio.

Last night, we witnessed a disturbing display of hate and bigotry from Trump’s rally. His speakers unleashed a barrage of racist remarks, including one comedian who disgracefully called Puerto Rico an “island of garbage” and made a crude joke aimed at Latinos. The stereotypes didn’t stop there: Black and Jewish people were also attacked. And to top it all off, _he alluded to Vice President Harris being a prostitute._

**This “comedian” was one of SEVERAL opening speakers who spewed sexist, racist, and otherwise demeaning insults. What we saw last night was a chilling preview of the extremism we can expect from another Trump presidency–one dialed up to 100. It’s a dangerous attempt to incite violence among his base should he lose the upcoming election.**

This isn’t just an unfortunate event; it’s fascism in its most blatant form, and we can’t allow it to gain more power. With Trump and his allies normalizing this offensive behavior, our work to support diversity and condemn hate has never been more urgent.
